questions.prompt: What is the capital city of East Timor?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the East Timor article.

questions.proof: The capital and largest city, Dili, is home to one hundred and fifty thousand people.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of East Timor?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the East Timor article.

questions.proof: It is a member of the United Nations, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and the Community of Portuguese Language Countries.
